import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Drop exact duplicate rows (2 duplicates identified)
    df = df.drop_duplicates(keep='first').reset_index(drop=True)
    # Normalize label variants
    df['island'] = df['island'].astype('string').str.strip().replace({'Dram': 'Dream', 'Torgerson': 'Torgersen'})
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].astype('string').str.strip().str.lower()
    # Coerce numeric columns that may be stored as text (e.g. '180', '3,600')
    for col in ['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g', 'bill_length_mm', 'bill_depth_mm', 'year']:
        if df[col].dtype == object or df[col].dtype == 'string':
            df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col].astype('string').str.replace(',', '', regex=False).str.strip(), errors='coerce')
    # Range check on flipper length (min 170, max 235)
    df.loc[(df['flipper_length_mm'] < 170) | (df['flipper_length_mm'] > 235), 'flipper_length_mm'] = np.nan
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    d = df.dropna(subset=['species', 'flipper_length_mm'])
    g = d.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()
    return {k: float(v) for k, v in g.items()}
